name: Workplace Concierge
description: Helps employees find and book desks and meeting rooms, see who is in the office, and manage their bookings using an interactive office map.

conversation_starters.text: Show me the office map for tomorrow so I can book a desk

conversation_starters.title: My bookings
conversation_starters.text: Show my upcoming desk and room bookings

conversation_starters.title: Who's in?
conversation_starters.text: Who is in the office today?

conversation_starters.title: Second floor
conversation_starters.text: Show me the seat map for floor 2

conversation_starters.title: Busy days
conversation_starters.text: How busy is the office over the next few days?
